deviation: Jakarta built-in option enums such as `LockModeType` remain D enums. `EntityManager` option overloads accept them at the API boundary, as in `em.find!Owner(id, LockModeType.PESSIMISTIC_WRITE)`. Provider-defined options use `FindOption` and `RefreshOption`.
reason: D enums cannot implement interfaces. The enum keeps `NamedQuery.lockMode` a compile-time UDA value.
